headline: Intel Shares Fall 21% Following Israel Factory Explosion and Weak PC Demand
summary: Intel shares dropped 21% following an October explosion at its Kiryat Gat factory in Israel that killed two workers, alongside ongoing weakness in PC demand.
why: Intel is one of the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers, supplying microprocessors for global personal computers and servers.

impacts.name: Intel Corp.
impacts.why: Production disruptions combined with sluggish PC demand weighed heavily on market valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A factory explosion in Israel resulting in casualties combined with soft PC demand forecasts pushed shares down 21%.
